system_description.narrative_title: China recalibrates power: domestic control, economic strain, and global outreach
system_description.narrative_summary: Across this window, a single narrative dominates: China is tightening political and technological controls at home while energetically expanding its external influence through BRICS and trade deals, even as its economy shows signs of strain and global financial links fray. These dynamics interact with volatile capital flows and rising US-China financial and diplomatic engagement, producing feedbacks across markets, supply chains and multilateral politics.
system_description.scope: The system boundary covers China's politico-economic complex: domestic macroeconomy (credit, investment, consumption, property), state control measures (tech export/exit rules, travel restrictions, legal reach), industrial policy (semiconductors, state-backed firms), corporate behavior (reshoring/foreign investment, MNCs in China), energy import deals (LNG contracts), and external diplomatic/financial linkages with major counterparts (US, India, BRICS partners) and global markets.
system_description.super_system: The global geopolitical-economic order: US-China strategic competition, international finance and capital markets, global trade and energy systems, and the evolving multilateral architecture.
adjacent_subsystems: Global financial markets (sovereign bond markets, FX, capital flows)
Global technology and semiconductor supply chains

variables.name: Domestic credit growth
variables.description: Rate of change in total credit extended within the domestic economy to households and firms.

variables.name: Domestic investment rate
variables.description: Rate of fixed‑capital formation or investment spending as a share of economic output over time.

variables.name: Household consumption demand
variables.description: Aggregate flow of household consumption expenditure and its growth dynamics.

variables.name: Real estate price level
variables.description: Average valuation level of the residential property stock reflecting market prices and trends.

variables.name: State control intensity
variables.description: Overall intensity and breadth of political, regulatory and administrative controls applied to the economy and technology sectors.

variables.name: Technology export restriction stringency
variables.description: Degree of restrictions and controls on the transfer, export or external sharing of advanced technologies.

variables.name: Legal reach abroad
variables.description: Extent to which domestic legal and regulatory measures are applied extraterritorially or target actors outside the territory.

variables.name: Industrial policy support level
variables.description: Magnitude and targeting intensity of state support instruments (subsidies, procurement, directed finance) for priority industries.

variables.name: Advanced manufacturing capacity
variables.description: Installed capacity and technological capability in advanced manufacturing sectors (e.g., semiconductor fabrication and other high‑tech production).

variables.name: Corporate outbound investment flow
variables.description: Net flow of corporate investment capital deployed from domestic firms into foreign assets, operations or acquisitions.

variables.name: Corporate reshoring rate
variables.description: Rate at which firms relocate production, supply‑chain nodes or investment back to domestic territory from abroad.

variables.name: Cross‑border capital flow volatility
variables.description: Short‑term volatility and churn in capital moving across borders, impacting liquidity and asset prices domestically.

variables.name: External financial link strength
variables.description: Degree of integration, depth and resilience of connections between the domestic financial system and external capital markets.

variables.name: Multilateral cooperation alignment
variables.description: Degree of alignment, access and influence within multilateral political and economic cooperation frameworks.

variables.name: Energy import contracting rate
variables.description: Rate of signing and committing to long‑term energy import contracts and supply agreements (e.g., LNG deals).

variables.name: Market risk premium perception
variables.description: Investor perception of the additional return required to hold domestic assets, reflecting risk sentiment and confidence.

catalysts.title: Bessent meets He Lifeng in New York
catalysts.description: Scheduled weekend meeting between US Treasury's Scott Bessent and China's He Lifeng that could shape short‑term financial dialogue and risk sentiment.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Bessent will meet with China's He Lifeng this weekend' — could ease market frictions and improve financial linkages.

catalysts.title: Trump‑Xi summit and associated talks
catalysts.description: High‑level summit between US and Chinese leaders that may recalibrate trade, investment and multilateral cooperation dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Scott Bessent to meet He Lifeng' and 'Trump‑Xi summit' — summit itself likely to move cooperation and market sentiment.

catalysts.title: Enforcement of new tech/national security exit rules
catalysts.description: Implementation and enforcement of tightened export/exit rules for technology and talent, constraining flows and compliance costs.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China tightens exit restrictions' and 'new tech, national security exit rules take effect' — enforcement will raise controls on tech flows.

catalysts.title: New overseas travel and exit controls implementation
catalysts.description: Sweeping law restricting overseas travel and widening exit controls, affecting mobility of talent and capital flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China tightens control of overseas travel' and 'wealthy Chinese, tech talent confront tighter borders' — reduces outbound mobility and investment.

catalysts.title: Acceleration of long‑term LNG import contracting
catalysts.description: Renewed signing of long‑term LNG import agreements as state and firms secure supplies, expanding contracted energy links.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China Gas signs 20-year LNG import deal' plus Chevron/QatarEnergy LNG deal activity — points to more long‑term contracting.

catalysts.title: Persistent slow domestic credit growth
catalysts.description: Continuation of weak bank lending and a 'new normal' of slower loan growth, constraining credit availability.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China August bank lending disappoints' and 'slower loan growth is the new normal' — credit, investment, consumption pressured.

catalysts.title: Return of firms and rise in China investment
catalysts.description: Some companies and foreign investors increase onshore investment or reshore production, reversing parts of prior exodus.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Companies left China... now some are heading back' and 'German firms lift China investment' — suggests reshoring/return flows.

catalysts.title: Ongoing weakness in home prices and property market
catalysts.description: Continued weak residential prices that weigh on household wealth, investment and consumption dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China home prices remain weak' and 'retail sales miss forecast' — property weakness persists, hitting demand.

catalysts.title: BRICS cooperation and payments link expansion
catalysts.description: BRICS summit momentum and payments systems linkage efforts that deepen alternative multilateral financial ties.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Xi urges BRICS' and 'Booming BRICS payments systems seek more cross-border links' — pushes alternative cooperation and links.

catalysts.title: State/industry push to scale advanced chipmaking
catalysts.description: Accelerated domestic efforts (led by Huawei and others) to expand advanced manufacturing capacity in semiconductors.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Huawei drives China’s push to make advanced chips' — boosts manufacturing and targeted industrial support.
